verdict.rationale: Avalara documents first-party AI capabilities (Avi Agent, AI-assisted tax code recommendations, and AI-assisted analysis that can 'explain how and why tax was calculated' via jurisdiction breakdowns, sourcing decisions, exemption status, and compliance rules) drawn from its own rule base rather than a generic chatbot. missing for 10: explicit citation of specific statute/rule sources in AI answers, and a documented worked example answering 'is this taxable in this state'
